Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Marcos picks Rodil Zalameda as new chief justice

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. chooses Associate Justice Rodil Zalameda as the country’s 28th Supreme Court chief justice.

items: Why Ralph Sarmiento refused to testify at Sara Duterte’s trial

blocks.text: Former law school dean Ralph Sarmiento declines Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team’s request for him to testify for her impeachment trial.

items: Romualdez is jailed, but can he keep staff in his cell?

blocks.text: Circulating reports claim former speaker Martin Romualdez is allowed to go in and out of the New Quezon City Jail in Payatas where he is detained.

items: Inflation surges to 7.8% in October 2026 as fuel prices, fares climb

blocks.text: Philippine inflation surges to 7.8% in October 2026, marking the highest rate since February 2023.

items: Canada’s Mark Carney to attend ASEAN Summit in Manila

blocks.text: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney will attend the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations or ASEAN Summit in the Philippines. – Rappler.com
